2016-05-21 Estadio Santiago Bernabéu, Madrid, Spain

Share: 

Scheduled: 21:00 Local Start Time 21:12 / End Time 00:29

Info & Setlist | Venue

33-song set with tour debuts for "My City Of Ruins" and "Land Of Hope And Dreams". "Trapped" is played by sign request. Final tour appearance for "Human Touch". "Thunder Road" is moved to the closing spot and performed in a solo acoustic version for the first time on the tour. "Two Hearts" includes "It Takes Two".

Official concert recording available for purchase in multiple formats, including CD and high definition audio, from Springsteen's official live download site at nugs.net/bruce (previously live.brucespringsteen.net).

  • Running Time: 3:18:03

Intro to “Badlands”
“Hola, Madrid! (crowd cheers) vamos (crowd cheers)…”

Intro to “Sherry Darling”
“Madrid, let me hear you (crowd cheers) mas alto, mas alto (crowd cheers)…”

Intro to “My City of Ruins”
“Alright…buenas noches, Madrid (crowd cheers) estamos muy contentos de estar (?) ciudad (crowd cheers) oh yeah now…alright now…”

Intro to “Hungry Heart”
“Yes, yes…yes, yes…are we ready? (crowd cheers) are we ready? (crowd cheers) are we ready? (crowd cheers)…”

Intro to “Spirit in the Night”
“Can you feel the spirit? (crowd cheers) can you feel the spirit now? (crowd cheers) can you feel the spirit? (crowd cheers) can you feel the spirit now? (crowd cheers) if you can feel the spirit, I want you to answer me with a “Yeah, yeah”…can you feel the spirit? (band and crowd: “Yeah, yeah”) can you feel the spirit now? (band and crowd: “Yeah, yeah”) can you feel the spirit? (band and crowd: “Yeah, yeah”) can you feel the spirit now? (band and crowd: “Yeah, yeah”)…”

Middle of “Glory Days”
“Come on, Steve, keep rocking, baby (Steve: “I’m with you, baby”) we can’t stop now, buddy (Steve: “I hear you, I hear you”) because you know what time it is (Steve: “What time is it?”)(band stops) it ain’t quitting time, it ain’t sexy time, it’s (crowd: “Boss-time”)…”

Middle of “Twist and Shout”
“On the guitar, Soozie Tyrell (crowd cheers) on the organ, Charles Giordano (crowd cheers) on the guitar, Nils Lofgren (crowd cheers) on the saxophone, Jake Clemons (crowd cheers) on the drums, Mighty Max (crowd cheers) on the piano, Roy Bittan (crowd cheers) on the bass, Garry Tallent (crowd cheers) on guitar and vocals, Miss Patti Scialfa (crowd cheers) and on the guitar, Little Steven Van Zandt (crowd cheers) Madrid! (crowd cheers) Madrid! (crowd cheers) Madrid! (crowd cheers) Madrid! (crowd cheers) you’ve just seen the heart-stopping, pants-dropping, Earth-shocking, born rocking, booty-shaking, earth-quaking, lovemaking, Viagra-taking, history-making, testifying, death-defying, legendary E (crowd: “Street Band!”)…”

Intro to “Thunder Road”
“Thank you so much…vos queremos, Madrid (crowd cheers) muchas gracias…”

After “Thunder Road”
“Thank you, Madrid (crowd cheers) muchas gracias (crowd cheers) vos queremos (crowd cheers) the E Street Band loves you (crowd cheers) thank you for a beautiful night, thank you (crowd cheers)…”

Compiled by : Johanna Pirttijärvi.
